name: Social content drafts
tagline: A week of post drafts, ready for you to skim and tweak
description: Tell us your beat and your voice. Each week your team drafts a handful of posts — one short for X, one longer for LinkedIn, one teaser for the next blog — and saves them in a single file you can edit and schedule.
starterPrompt: Draft five short social posts for me this week — three for X (tweet-length), two for LinkedIn (~120 words). Topic: the experience of running my own AI workforce on my laptop. Voice: candid, slightly nerdy, no hype. Save as 'Social drafts — <this week>.md'.
defaultGoal: Show up consistently on social without burning a morning on it every week.
